claim: disrobe declares 101 container, archive, and firmware formats and carries an in-tree payload extractor for each, with no metadata-only or external-tool-gated formats. 41 of the 101 are driven to member bytes on disk by an input this repository commits. The other 60 have no committed input, so they are unverified rather than shown to fail.
detail: 101 formats detected, and each declares a payload extractor. 41 of them write member bytes from an input this repository commits, which is the measured leg. The other 60 have no committed input, so nothing here states whether their extractors work.
gate_source: ContainerKind enum crates/disrobe-binfmt/src/container.rs (ContainerKind::ALL is [Self; 101], 101 real variants excluding None), asserted in detected_count_is_one_hundred_and_one; every one of the 101 declares a payload extractor rather than a metadata summary or an external-tool hand-off, asserted in every_declared_format_carries_a_payload_extractor, which is a roster declaration and not a run. The delivered count is the measured leg: 41 of the 101 are driven to member bytes on disk by an input this repository commits, measured by crates/disrobe-cli/tests/container_breadth.rs over `git ls-files`, pinned in crates/disrobe-cli/tests/golden/container_breadth.txt and read back by published_container_counts_match_this_enum. The remaining 60 carry an extractor no committed input reaches, so they are unverified rather than shown to fail: absence of an input is not evidence of a broken extractor, and nothing here claims they work. The declared superset spans archives/installers (ZIP/tar/7z/RAR/cab/MSI/NSIS/deb/rpm/Docker/OCI/ISO), bare single-stream compression (gz/bz2/zst/lzma/lzip/lz4-frame/zlib/.Z), legacy archives (ar/arj/arc/lzh/lzop/uzip/xamarin-xalz/par2/ELF-overlay carve), embedded-linux filesystems (squashfs/cramfs/ext4/romfs/minixfs/jffs2/ubi-ubifs/yaffs/erofs/ntfs/android-sparse/btrfs-send), disk-image/partition containers (GPT/MBR/VHD/VHDX/WIM walked through FAT), .NET single-file bundles (majors 1/2/6, deflate-compressed and stored entries), and vendor firmware decryptors (D-Link AES/EnGenius XOR/Autel table/QNAP PC1 plus CRC-verified Netgear/Xiaomi/Tesla carves); a recursive carve-everything engine (multi-magic scan, chunk model, depth recursion, entropy gating) drives nested extraction. Inno Setup follows finite setup-data profiles from 4.0.9 through 7.0.0.3 and recovers stored, zlib, BZip2, LZMA1, and LZMA2 members from non-solid and solid groups with versioned checksums; InstallShield legacy cabinets (`ISc(` majors 0 and 5) write their stored members and both legacy raw-DEFLATE representations, the u16-length chunk framing and the full-flush end-of-chunk framing, with obfuscated members decoded before inflate; StuffIt method 13 is decoded with exact fork lengths and CRCs, while the remaining unsupported heavy codec legs retain their documented extraction boundary
measured: 41 extracted from a committed input / 101 detected

oracle.external: the delivered count is disrobe extracting from its own committed corpus and counting the formats that wrote bytes, not an independent check. Individual format tests may use external byte manifests, but the 62 formats with no committed input carry no measurement at all

title: Container, archive, and firmware in-tree extraction
